name: Pylon
description_en:
Pylon is a B2B support platform combining customer issues across channels, account context, knowledge, routing and human/AI collaboration. Current agent features include Assist Agent, event or scheduled Automations, reusable Skills and connectors to external tools. A customer issue, an account record and the agent permitted to act on them are distinct parts of the workflow.

Its current offer combines paid seats and agentic credits, with account intelligence and phone add-ons. Evaluation should trace a customer thread through issue/ticket events, assignment, tool identity and escalation rather than equating channel access with autonomous resolution. This is public-documentation research; no workspace, connector, AI action, message, bill or export was tested.
description_zh:
Pylon 是B2B支持平台，将跨渠道客户问题、账户上下文、知识、路由及人工／AI协作结合。当前代理功能包含Assist Agent、事件或定时Automations、可复用Skills及外部工具连接器。客户问题、账户记录与获准操作的代理，是流程中不同部分。

当前方案结合付费席位和代理积分，另有账户智能及电话附加项。评估应将客户线程追踪至issue／ticket事件、分配、工具身份及升级，不能把渠道接入等同自主解决。本文为公开文档研究，未测试工作区、连接器、AI动作、消息、账单或导出。

core_features.explanation_en: Use channels and account context to coordinate support work.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用渠道和账户上下文协调支持工作。

core_features.explanation_en: Run configured AI instructions or Skills with available context and tools.
core_features.explanation_zh: 以可用上下文和工具运行已配置AI指令或Skills。

core_features.name_zh: 区分身份的外部连接器
core_features.explanation_en: Personal, shared and dedicated agent connections have different external identities.
core_features.explanation_zh: 个人、共享及专用代理连接采用不同外部身份。

en: Investigate an engineering-facing B2B support issue with scoped code/log context.
Pilot human-reviewed triage before assigning customer-facing work to an agent.
zh: 使用限定代码／日志上下文排查面向工程团队的B2B支持问题。
将客户工作交给代理前，试点人工审阅的分诊。
use_cases.basis: Editorial scenarios; no measured outcomes or deployed workflow.

Action authority.en: The agent’s enabledtools and connectionidentity govern externalcalls; the external system retains responsibility for tenant and permission enforcement.
Action authority.zh: 代理启用的工具及连接身份决定外部调用，外部系统仍负责租户和权限执行。

steps.en: Choose a narrow issue/channel and define the customer account, owner and escalation team.
steps.zh: 选择窄范围问题／渠道，定义客户账户、负责人及升级团队。

steps.en: Review a small Skill and connector identity; test with representative channel/account/contact values.
steps.zh: 审阅小范围Skill及连接器身份，使用代表性渠道／账户／联系人测试。

steps.en: Confirm seat minimum, credit commitment/price, product access and trial order before enabling automation.
steps.zh: 启用自动化前确认席位最低量、积分承诺／价格、产品权限及试用订单。

items.en: New issue plus turned-into-ticket kickoffs run twice for a new ticket; this can duplicate actions.
items.zh: 新issue加转为ticket两个启动事件会对新工单运行两次，可能重复动作。

items.en: Support Agent documentation still labels beta access, so a listed pricing feature does not establish every tenant can use it.
items.zh: Support Agent文档仍标beta权限，价格列出不代表每个租户都可用。

items.en: Customer/channel simulation does not establish all external tool side effects are suppressed.
items.zh: 客户／渠道模拟不能证明所有外部工具副作用均被抑制。

pricing.billing_basis: Seats plus agenticcredits andoptionaladd-ons;89/139perseatcards specifyannualcontract butdonotstateclearperiodunit there, soamountsnotnormalized.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Professional89/seat andAdvanced139/seat onannualcontract,Enterprisequote. Agenticcredits minimum5000; seatminimumexistsbutcountnotpublished. AccountIntelligence10/customeraccount/month,Phone35/seat/month,SAMLAdvanced125/month. Creditunitprice andexactbillneedquote. Trialarrangedbysales,notfreeplan.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Professional每席位89、Advanced139，标年合同；Enterprise询价。代理积分至少5000，席位有最低量但未公布人数。账户智能每客户账户每月10、电话每席每月35、Advanced SAML每月125。积分单价及准确账单需报价。试用由销售安排，不是免费套餐。

faq.question_en: Are Automations free once seats are purchased?
faq.answer_en: The pricing page lists agentic use as requiring credits. A seat feature listing is not an unlimited AI allowance.
faq.answer_zh: 价格页将代理用量列为需积分，席位功能列出不等于无限AI额度。

faq.question_en: Does attaching a connector import all external data?
faq.question_zh: 连接器接上就导入全部外部数据吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The guide says it exposes selected tools for calls as needed, with the external service retaining its permissions and tenant boundaries.
faq.answer_zh: 不是，指南称其按需开放选定工具调用，外部服务仍负责权限及租户边界。

official_check.scope: Public vendor documentation reviewed; no account execution, purchase, owner identity, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Track a customer problem through the B2B workspace
sections.title_zh: 在B2B工作区追踪客户问题
sections.en:
Pylon’s current positioning joins human and AI work around B2B issues rather than treating each channel as an isolated inbox. Automations can investigate a new issue using documentation, previous issues, account fields, connected code or logs. The actual tools and context granted to the workspace determine what is available.

For an illustrative API failure, tie the customer thread to the correct account, collect reproduction details and identify the engineering handoff owner. Keep an internal investigation distinct from a public reply or an external write. A customer logo, sample walkthrough or agentic label does not independently verify resolution quality, speed or access to the right tenant’s data.
sections.zh:
Pylon当前定位是围绕B2B问题连接人工及AI工作，而非将各渠道视为孤立收件箱。Automations可使用文档、旧问题、账户字段及已连代码／日志调查新问题，实际可用内容由工作区获准工具与上下文决定。

以假设API故障为例，应将客户线程归到正确账户，收集复现资料并确定工程交接负责人。内部调查、公开回复和外部写入需区分。客户标志、示例演示或代理标签，不能独立验证解决质量、速度或正确租户的数据访问。

sections.title_en: Count kickoff events before sending an automatic message
sections.title_zh: 自动发送消息前先核对启动事件数量
sections.en:
Triggers combine a kickoff, conditions/delays and ordered actions. The guide says every ticket starts as an issue: selecting both new-issue and issue-turned-into-ticket events makes new tickets run twice. A new-message event can include an internal note, so sender and message-type filters matter. Within a trigger, condition branches run top to bottom and only the first matching flow runs.

Use one narrow kickoff and inspect the complete action list. Public messages, internal notes, assignment, status and external notifications have different effects; available actions depend on the object and sometimes source channel. Test repeated updates and delivery failures before relying on automation. This documentation does not establish every action has automatic retry, deduplication or rollback.
sections.zh:
触发器组合启动事件、条件／延迟及有序动作。指南称每个ticket起初都是issue，同时选择新issue与issue转ticket，会使新工单运行两次。新消息事件可包含内部备注，因此发送者和消息类型过滤很重要。单触发器内条件分支自上而下检查，只执行首个匹配流程。

应使用窄范围单启动事件并检查完整动作列表。公开消息、内部备注、分配、状态及外部通知影响不同；可用动作取决于对象，有时也取决于来源渠道。依赖自动化前应测试重复更新及投递失败，文档不能证明每个动作都有自动重试、去重或回滚。

sections.title_en: A reusable Skill still needs a bounded identity
sections.title_zh: 可复用Skill仍需要限定身份
sections.en:
Skills are instructions reusable across agents, manual assistance and event/scheduled Automations. They can be scoped to the organization, teams or individual members, while each agent controls the Skills it can use. Generated instructions should be reviewed before attaching them. Access also depends on plan and role permissions.

Connectors distinguish personal accounts, shared organizational accounts and dedicated agent/service accounts. Pylon governs callable tools, but the connected service enforces its own tenant permissions. A custom API tool supports public HTTP/HTTPS rather than private-network or loopback addresses. Verify which identity reads logs or changes an engineering ticket, and how denied access is handled; importing a Skill does not authorize its requested actions.
sections.zh:
Skills是可跨代理、手动辅助及事件／定时Automations复用的指令，可限定组织、团队或成员，各代理另控可用Skills。生成指令应审阅后再挂载，访问也受套餐和角色权限限制。

连接器区分个人账户、组织共享账户及专用代理／服务账户。Pylon控制可调用工具，但连接服务执行自身租户权限。自定义API工具支持公开HTTP／HTTPS，而非私网或回环地址。应验证读取日志或修改工程工单采用哪个身份，以及拒绝访问如何处理；导入Skill不代表其请求动作获授权。

sections.title_en: Verify availability and escalation in the actual account
sections.title_zh: 在真实账户确认可用性与升级
sections.en:
Support Agent documentation still marks the feature beta with limited access, even though the current pricing matrix lists it among credit-based capabilities. Confirm the selected workspace’s actual access. The test guide supports custom chat with chosen channel, account and contact, and testing against past issues. It does not promise every connected external write is simulated.

Deployment is assignment-based: manually assign an issue or use a narrowly scoped trigger. If the agent cannot answer, the guide says it follows the configured escalation workflow and reassigns. Inspect an unknown question, unavailable recipient, permission denial and wrong-account context before customer-facing use. No simulation, handoff or action was executed here.
sections.zh:
Support Agent文档仍标为限量beta，即使当前价格矩阵将其列入按积分能力，仍需确认所选工作区实际权限。测试指南支持指定渠道、账户及联系人进行自定义聊天，以及用旧问题测试，但未承诺每个外部写入均模拟。

部署采用分配：手动交给代理，或用窄范围触发器。无法回答时，指南称按配置升级流程重分配。面向客户前应检查未知问题、接收人不可用、拒绝权限及错误账户上下文。此次未执行模拟、交接或动作。

sections.title_en: Budget for seats, credits and add-ons separately
sections.title_zh: 分别预算席位、积分与附加项
sections.en:
Current cards show Professional$89/seat and Advanced$139/seat on annual contracts, with Enterprise quoted. The card itself does not state a clear monthly period, so this profile does not normalize those amounts. Standard contracts are annual; monthly billing is also mentioned. Seats include people working tickets, including inbox-access admins, while viewer allocation is arranged with sales. New customers have an unspecified seat minimum.

Agentic features consume purchased credits with a minimum5,000commitment. Credit unit price, model of consumption and low-balance fallback need the order. Account Intelligence is$10/customer-account/month, Phone$35/seat/month and Advanced SAML$125/month. Trial organizations are arranged by sales; evaluation terms can include an order-based paid conversion. Confirm the full quote, credit term and export/retention scope before starting.
sections.zh:
当前卡片显示Professional每席位$89、Advanced$139并标年合同，Enterprise询价。卡片本身未明确月度单位，因此本文不标准化金额。标准合同为年，也提可月付。席位包含处理工单的人及有收件箱权限管理员，查看者数量由销售安排；新客户有未公开人数的席位最低量。

代理功能消耗购买积分，最低承诺5000。积分单价、消耗模型及低余额回退需订单明确。账户智能每客户账户每月$10，电话每席每月$35，Advanced SAML每月$125。试用组织由销售安排，评估条款可包含依订单转付费。开始前应确认完整报价、积分期限及导出／保留范围。
